title: Before, after, since
goal: Put events in order with -mAdAn önce and -DIktAn sonra, and say how long it has been since something happened with -(y)AlI.

intro.text: **Before** an action is `-mAdAn önce` (*yatmadan önce*), and **after** is `-DIktAn sonra` (*yedikten sonra*). For the time since something happened, use `-(y)AlI` with *oldu*: *Buraya geleli üç yıl oldu* (It's been three years since I came here).

exercises.en: After eating, we went for a walk.

exercises.question: How do you say **before going to bed**?

why.2: With a verb, **before** is `-mAdAn önce`, not the infinitive.

exercises.explain: *yat-ma-dan önce*: it looks negative, but it means **before going to bed**.

exercises.prompt: Check your passport before you leave home.
accept: Evden çıkmadan önce pasaportunu kontrol et.
Pasaportunu evden çıkmadan önce kontrol et.

reject.answer: Evden çıktıktan önce pasaportunu kontrol et.
reject.why: **Before** an action is `-mAdAn önce`: *çıkmadan önce*. `-DIktAn` only goes with *sonra*.

exercises.prompt: Üniversiteden mezun olduktan sonra İzmir'e taşındı.
accept: After graduating from university, she moved to Izmir.
After graduating from [university|college], he moved to Izmir.
After graduating from college, she moved to Izmir.
After he graduated from (the) [university|college], he moved to Izmir.
After she graduated from (the) [university|college], she moved to Izmir.
He moved to Izmir after [graduating|he graduated] from (the) [university|college].
She moved to Izmir after [graduating|she graduated] from (the) [university|college].

exercises.gloss: after going (the form used before sonra)
exercises.explain: `-DIk` starts with a consonant, so *git-* keeps its t, and d becomes t after it. The ablative follows, also with t: *git-tik-ten sonra*.

exercises.en: It's been three years since I came here.
I haven't seen you for ages!
exercises.explain: *gör-me-y-eli*: the negative + `-(y)AlI`, **since I last saw you**. With *çok oldu*: it's been a long time.

exercises.prompt: It has been ten years since we got married.

reject.why: **Since** with a time span is `-(y)AlI`: *evleneli on yıl oldu*.

exercises.text: After they retired, they moved to the village.
accept: They moved to the village after they retired.

exercises.question: *Ali gittikten sonra Ayşe geldi.* Who was there first?
exercises.explain: *Ali git-tik-ten sonra*: after Ali left, Ayşe came. The two parts can have different subjects.

exercises.en: I read before going to bed.

accept: It has been a long time!
It has been a long time since we (last) [saw each other|met]!
It's been a long time since we (last) [saw each other|met]!
We have not seen each other [for|in] [a long time|ages]!

exercises.prompt: After the meeting ends, I'll call you again.
accept: Toplantı bittikten sonra seni yeniden ararım.
Toplantı bittikten sonra sizi yeniden ararım.

reject.answer: Toplantı bitmeden sonra seni yeniden ararım.
